characters.description: One timeline per recurring character across the whole film.

states.description: Whole-film appearance timeline in screen order. `from` ids are GLOBAL scene ids — plan.chapter_merge shifted each chapter-local id by the number of sections in preceding chapters. A state holds from its `from` scene until the next one; plan.character_states forward-fills it onto every shot.

from.description: GLOBAL scene id at which this state comes into force.

fromChapter.description: Which chapter declared this state (added by the merge, for tracing).

fromLocal.description: The chapter-local id before shifting (added by the merge, for tracing).
